# INTRX — The Interaction Library

> A curated, copy-paste library of the web interactions used by award-winning
> design agencies. 549 native patterns are implemented, including the full 52-entry DRAMS collection.
> Each pattern ships three things: a live demo, a single-file HTML+CSS+JS
> snippet, and an LLM prompt that specifies the interaction precisely enough
> to rebuild it in any framework.

Site: https://intrx.vercel.app
Registry: https://intrx.vercel.app/registry/index.json
License: MIT; photographs under the Unsplash License with per-component attribution. DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp).

## Components

- [Magnetic Button](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/magnetic-button): hover · The button leans toward the pointer, then springs back · registry: /registry/c/magnetic-button.json
- [Gooey Menu](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/svg-gooey-menu): press · A central action expands four child bubbles through a true SVG blur and alpha-threshold filter. A separate synchronized button layer keeps icons, labels, keyboard navigation, and focus rings crisp while the colored shapes visibly merge beneath them. · registry: /registry/c/svg-gooey-menu.json
- [Liquid Buttons](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/liquid-blob-buttons): hover · A liquid membrane fills the button you touch · registry: /registry/c/liquid-blob-buttons.json

- [Fireflies](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fireflies-night): hover · Seeded fireflies wander with individual phase noise and pulsing light. A stationary pointer becomes an attractor only after an idle delay, so exploration stays loose before the swarm gathers. · registry: /registry/c/fireflies-night.json
- [Aurora](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/aurora-curtains): hover · Four feathered atmospheric curtains follow phase-shifted sine envelopes and blend through diffuse vertical light. Pointer movement pushes a temporary horizontal gust through the nearest curtain segment. · registry: /registry/c/aurora-curtains.json
- [Rain on Glass](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/rain-window): press · Seeded droplets creep down glass with lateral random walk, refractive highlights, and size-dependent speed. Nearby drops coalesce into a heavier drop that accelerates down the pane. · registry: /registry/c/rain-window.json
- [Inertial Dot Field](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-dot-field): hover · A precise dot lattice yields around the pointer with damped spring inertia. Click emits a radial impulse; each dot returns to its original position. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-dot-field.json
- [Reactive Threads](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-threads): hover · Thirty-six fine filaments bend as a continuous field around the pointer. A Gaussian falloff keeps the edges quiet while the center feels elastic. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-threads.json
- [Tactile Ballpit](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-ballpit): hover · A small pile of dimensional spheres responds to pointer collisions, gravity, and impulse. Pairwise collision resolution separates the bodies, while damping keeps the motion controlled. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-ballpit.json
- [Ripple Grid](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-ripple-grid): hover · A continuous wire lattice ripples outward from the pointer. Distance-based sine displacement and exponential falloff create the impression of a flexible mesh without WebGL. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-ripple-grid.json
- [Magnetic Line Field](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-magnet-lines): hover · A grid of short needles rotates toward a local attractor. Proximity controls line length and contrast, turning a simple angle calculation into a tactile magnetic field. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-magnet-lines.json
- [Contour Mesh](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-mesh-surface): hover · A sculptural contour surface folds in response to pointer position. This lightweight Canvas 2D study translates the reference’s material movement into fine orange and graphite linework rather than reproducing its shader. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-mesh-surface.json
- [Perspective Warp](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-warp-tunnel): hover · Nested wire rectangles travel out of a shared vanishing point. Pointer position shifts the perspective, while a brief click impulse changes the speed of the tunnel. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-warp-tunnel.json
- [Converging Paths](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-converging-paths): scroll · Five independently drawn SVG paths converge into a single signal. A local scroll container maps progress to normalized stroke lengths, keeping the effect usable inside a component preview. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-converging-paths.json
- [Path Follower](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/showcase-orbital-path): drag · A small object follows the exact geometry of an SVG curve. An accessible range input scrubs distance along the path, demonstrating a portable primitive for scroll-driven route and orbit animations. · registry: /registry/c/showcase-orbital-path.json
- [Plasma Orb](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-plasma-orb): ambient · A procedural plasma sphere combines four-octave flow noise, a Fresnel rim and a warm core. Move, touch or use the Arrow keys to bend the field; the source-clock renderer caps paint at sixty frames per second. · registry: /registry/c/fx-plasma-orb.json
- [Beam Collision Grid](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-beam-grid): ambient · Seeded beams fall along seven grid lines. - [Black Hole](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-black-hole): ambient · A lensed accretion disc wraps a dark event horizon. Move or use the Arrow keys to tilt the camera; the original WebGL field has a complete software fallback. · registry: /registry/c/fx-black-hole.json
- [Vortex](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-vortex): ambient · A seeded particle field spirals inward through a drifting flow. Source time drives every orbit, and pointer, touch or Arrow keys move the centre. · registry: /registry/c/fx-vortex.json
- [Lamp Glow](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-lamp): scroll · Scroll to widen a soft conic beam above Light the way. The light, blur and headline resolve from their current progress; native scroll and keyboard remain available. · registry: /registry/c/fx-lamp.json
- [Light Tunnel](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-light-tunnel): ambient · Concentric rounded frames rush toward a bright opening. All sixteen supplied native streaks remain intact; seeded travel and camera offsets share one source clock. · registry: /registry/c/fx-light-tunnel.json
- [Meteors](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/fx-meteors): ambient · Seeded meteors streak diagonally across the composition at reproducible random intervals. Every event has a complete head, gradient tail and finite retirement time. · registry: /registry/c/fx-meteors.json

- [Retro Grid](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/bg-retro-grid): ambient · A ray-cast perspective floor scrolls toward the viewer with level-of-detail line thinning, so distant cells never shimmer. - [Ripple](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/bg-ripple): ambient · Concentric rings breathe outward from a device-search icon, each one a little fainter and 60ms later than the last, fading toward the bottom of the stage. - [Animated Grid Pattern](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/bg-animated-grid-pattern): ambient · A 40px hairline grid where fifty squares fade in over four seconds, hold, fade out and reappear somewhere else, about a quarter of them in the accent, behind a status headline. - [Dot Pattern](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/bg-dot-pattern): ambient · A 16px dot grid where every dot breathes on its own two-to-five-second cycle and one in eleven glows in the accent, fading out toward the edges behind a headline. ## Effects

- [Smooth Scroll](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/lenis-smooth-scroll): scroll · Four editorial sections scroll with wheel momentum and a gentle landing. Native touch and keyboard scrolling remain available. · registry: /registry/c/lenis-smooth-scroll.json
- [Stagger Reveal](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-reveal-stagger): scroll · Six cards rise and resolve in reading order when their group enters the scroll viewport. Scrolling away resets the reveal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-reveal-stagger.json
- [Parallax Layers](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/parallax-layers): scroll · Layers move at different speeds relative to scroll, faking depth. Background drifts slowly, foreground overtakes — a two-line transform with outsized effect. · registry: /registry/c/parallax-layers.json
- [Horizontal Scroll](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/horizontal-scroll): scroll · Vertical scrolling pins the section and drives a horizontal track — the signature gallery pattern of portfolio and case-study sites. · registry: /registry/c/horizontal-scroll.json
- [Sticky Stack](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/sticky-stack): scroll · Cards pin on top of each other while scrolling; each incoming card slightly scales down the one beneath it. Pure CSS sticky with a pinch of JS. · registry: /registry/c/sticky-stack.json
- [Reading Progress](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-progress): scroll · A hairline bar that fills as you scroll, plus a live percentage readout. Small detail, strong "crafted" signal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-progress.json
- [Velocity Skew](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/velocity-skew): scroll · Content skews proportionally to scroll speed and eases back when you stop — the page feels like it has physical drag. A Locomotive Scroll signature. · registry: /registry/c/velocity-skew.json
- [Scroll Zoom](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-zoom): scroll · A pinned media block scales from an inset thumbnail to full-bleed as you scroll through the section — the cinematic "expand into the story" transition. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-zoom.json
- [Text Highlight](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-text-highlight): scroll · A long-form passage measures its own native scroll range and continuously fills each word from dim ink to bright paper-white, turning reading position into an exact sequential typographic signal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-text-highlight.json
- [Image Sequence](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-image-sequence): scroll · A product-style canvas scene advances through 48 discrete, procedurally rendered frames as the local scroll position changes. The result has the precise, authored cadence of an image sequence without downloading a video or sprite sheet. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-image-sequence.json
- [Route Draw](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-svg-draw): scroll · An editorial route diagram draws itself segment by segment as the local page scrolls. Every dash length is measured from the real SVG geometry, so the reveal remains exact when the paths change. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-svg-draw.json
- [Rotating Gallery](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-rotate-gallery): scroll · Seven editorial cards travel around a circular fan as the local panel scrolls. The card nearest the focus axis is selected from angular distance, then raised, sharpened, and scaled without relying on hard-coded active ranges. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-rotate-gallery.json
- [Split Screen](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-split-screen): scroll · Four narrative chapters scroll on the right while a pinned visual field on the left crossfades continuously between their paired scenes. The transition is derived from chapter progress, so copy, imagery, navigation, and accessibility remain in lockstep. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-split-screen.json
- [Crossing Marquees](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-marquee-direction): scroll · Three continuous type bands reverse when scroll direction changes, accelerate from measured scroll velocity, and lean into the impulse before settling upright. Direction persists; velocity decays independently. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-marquee-direction.json
- [Counter-Rotating Rings](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-counter-rotate): scroll · Two overlapping circular text paths rotate in opposite directions at different scroll ratios. A fixed optical center and synchronized angular telemetry make the counter-motion legible instead of ornamental noise. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-counter-rotate.json
- [Depth Tunnel](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-depth-tunnel): scroll · Nine nested portal frames travel from a distant vanishing point through the camera on an exponential scale curve. Frames recycle after crossing the near plane, creating continuous spatial travel from a finite DOM. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-depth-tunnel.json
- [Letter Scatter](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-letter-scatter): scroll · A headline breaks into individually routed glyphs as its section scrolls away. Every letter follows a deterministic quadratic Bézier trajectory, keeping the composition art-directed and perfectly repeatable. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-letter-scatter.json
- [Theme Shift](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-color-theme): scroll · A compact editorial page continuously interpolates its full color system between four section palettes. Background, surface, ink, muted text, borders, and accent all travel together instead of snapping at chapter boundaries. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-color-theme.json
- [Clip Morph](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-clip-morph): scroll · A circular hero aperture continuously becomes a full-bleed rectangle as the local section scrolls. Sixteen compatible polygon vertices preserve a real shape morph from first frame to last. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-clip-morph.json
- [Table of Contents](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-table-of-contents): scroll · A sticky table of contents tracks the section whose measured center is nearest the viewport center. - [Inertia Grid](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-inertia-grid): scroll · Three editorial columns share one native scroll target but converge on it at different rates.
